scope: Independent TI TMUX1511PW electrical and control pull-down review; not measured qualification

voltage_limits.S_D_absolute_supply_dependency: None in p4 table; all referenced to GND
voltage_limits.SEL_recommended: 0..5.5 V; fail-safe independent of VDD state per section7.3.5
voltage_limits.ramp_limit: At VDD1.5..1.65 V, a fixed3.3 V S/D exceeds the recommended operation range but not the absolute rating. Do not claim guaranteed Hi-Z or leakage across all ramp points; keep select low and validate ramp waveforms/current. At VDD=0, IPOFF maximum +/-2uA applies for VS0..3.6 V, VD0 V over full rated temperature; typical0.01uA is not a max.

control.IIL_test: VSEL=0 V; electrical table VDD1.5..5.5 V, TA-40..125C. Table lists +/-2uA in MAX column. Treat unfavorable leakage direction as source into pull-down.
control.internal_pull_down: 6 Mohm typical only, no minimum/maximum guaranteed; excluded from worst-case pull-down sizing.
control.TCA9539_IIL: P-port input VI=GND, VCC1.65..5.5 V, TA-40..85C: -1uA max magnitude; add1uA unfavorable source. Does not specify VCC=0 or brownout leakage.

SD_six_SEL.decision: Use R22310k external to GND;100k cannot establish worst-case default LOW.

TOUCH_four_SEL.decision: Use R21510k external to GND and update TOUCH sheet note.

control.power_budget: Each10k pull consumes330uA at3.3 V while enabled, plus switch/control input currents; not a standby current when held LOW. TMUX supply70uA max per IC in documented test conditions; two SD switches add140uA max as rail-on allocation.
control.limits: These calculations use specified endpoint leakage to size passive defaults with margin; actual AON/SD/TOUCH brownout and reset sequencing still need bench tests. No assumption of guaranteed IOX output behavior below valid VCC.

unused_channels.recommendation: Tie unused SEL3/SEL4 hard toGND; mark corresponding S3/D3/S4/D4 explicit no-connect. These are analog switch terminals, not CMOS logic inputs; do not confuse functional unused terminals with dedicated NC package pins.
unused_channels.used_channel_grouping: U701 all4SEL toSD_IO_EN, U706 SEL1/SEL2 toSD_IO_EN; U706 SEL3/SEL4 toGND. Both VDD=SD_3V3, local100n each.

reuse: Use exact existing ESPaperPlay:TMUX1511PW library definition from reviewed TOUCH page. Do not create another same-name shape/pin mapping.
